search_text: published ZDI-25-1056 ZDI-CAN-27220 (0Day) Microsoft ASP.NET SOAP Execution Restriction Bypass Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2025-12-10 5.0 AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L ['Microsoft'] ['.NET'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Microsoft ASP.NET. Authentication may be required to exploit this vulnerability depending upon configuration. Additionally, specific configuration is required. The specific flaw exists within the handling of SOAP web service definitions. A crafted uploaded file can bypass restrictions on code execution.
